decisions.reason: Operator training builds directly on the firm's established service offer and on its training capabilities, so it meets aspirations at low cost and supports machine sales.
The fourth rotary axis is a low-cost accessory that complements the core milling machines and raises system configurability, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core business, was only mentioned on the website, and has uncertain results, so after the 2020-2021 downturn that eroded slack, management is likely to redirect these resources to the core business.
The high-speed CNC milling line is central to the firm's identity and revenue, and as a multi-model line close to the core offer it is very unlikely to be withdrawn.
The automatic tool change system strengthens the productivity value of the core machines and fits the firm's modular engineering, so it likely performs at or above aspiration.
